name: news-update
description: Update one Tradebee news record with automatic pre-update backup.

news.description: Update payload; news_id required, all other news-create fields optional.

news_id.description: Required positive news ID selected from news-read.

newsgroup_id.description: Optional replacement group ID selected from newsgroup-read under the same language. Omit it to keep the current group.

publisher.description: Optional new publisher, up to 100 characters. Omit it to keep the current publisher.

publication_date.description: Optional new valid display date. Omit it to keep the current publication date.

source.description: Optional new source, up to 100 characters. Omit it to keep the current source.

title.description: Optional new title containing 2-500 characters. Omit it to keep the current title.

cover_image.description: Optional replacement cover image up to 500 kB. It cannot be automatically restored because news-read does not return original base64 data.

name.description: Required image file label when cover_image is supplied.

base64.description: Required image data with MIME prefix when cover_image is supplied; decoded size must not exceed 500 kB.

tags.description: Optional replacement array of 1-6 tags. Omit it to keep current tags.

summary.description: Optional new summary containing 10-500 characters. Omit it to keep the current summary.

description.description:
Optional new news-body HTML fragment. Only when replacing this field, first call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and exact `scene=news.description`; continue only after that call succeeds and follow the complete returned rule payload instead of guessing layout, styling, structure, theme, or link rules. The current rule requires one root `
` with a unique scoped class and one embedded `

seo.description: Optional SEO fields to change. Omit this object or an individual field to keep its current value.

title.description: Optional new SEO title, up to 90 characters. Omit it to keep the current title.

description.description: Optional new SEO description, up to 200 characters. Omit it to keep the current description.

keywords.description: Optional new comma-separated SEO keywords, up to 6 keywords and 120 total characters. Omit it to keep current keywords.

confirmation.description: Required explicit approval covering the exact update and backup.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language, update fields, and automatic backup approved by the user.

output.description: API result plus backup metadata, snapshot, and restore payload.
